exercise.title: Spider from the 1st fret
exercise.why: Low on the neck the frets are widest, so the spider there builds the stretch that today's open position needs.

cells.text: Press Play below to start the metronome and follow the tab: frets 1 to 4 with fingers 1, 2, 3 and 4 on every string, up and back. Practice until the stretch feels as easy as it did at the 5th fret.
